reference: She got her slides checked by her older brother the night before.
sk: Slajdy si dala skontrolovať od staršieho brata deň predtým.
cz: Slajdy si nechala zkontrolovat od staršího bratra den předtím.
acceptable: She {got|had} her slides checked by her {older|elder|big} brother the {night|day} before.
The {night|day} before, she {got|had} her slides checked by her {older|elder|big} brother.
She got her {older|elder|big} brother to check her slides the {night|day} before.
She had her {older|elder|big} brother check her slides the {night|day} before.

mistakes.text: She checked her slides by her older brother the {night|day} before.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Checked her slides“ znamená, že kontrolovala sama. Treba Causative: „got her slides checked“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Checked her slides“ znamená, že kontrolovala sama. Je potřeba Causative: „got her slides checked“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Checked her slides” means she did it herself; use the causative: “got her slides checked”.

mistakes.text: She got her slides check by her older brother the {night|day} before.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V Causative patrí za predmet past participle: „checked“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V Causative patří za předmět past participle: „checked“.
mistakes.feedback_en: In the causative the object is followed by the past participle: “checked”.

mistakes.text: She got checked her slides by her older brother the {night|day} before.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Poradie v Causative je „got + vec + past participle“: „got her slides checked“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Pořadí v Causative je „got + věc + past participle“: „got her slides checked“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The causative order is “got + object + past participle”: “got her slides checked”.

mistakes.text: She got her slides checked from her older brother the {night|day} before.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Kto činnosť robí, uvádza „by“, nie „from“: „checked by her older brother“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Kdo činnost dělá, uvádí „by“, ne „from“: „checked by her older brother“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The person who does the action is introduced with “by”, not “from”.

mistakes.text: She got her slides checked by older brother the {night|day} before.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pred „older brother“ chýba „her“: „by her older brother“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Před „older brother“ chybí „her“: „by her older brother“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Older brother” needs a possessive here: “by her older brother”.

source_issues: Slovak/Czech say 'deň/den predtým' (the day before), the English says 'the night before'; both accepted.
